working_controls_negatives_confirmed: CSRF: double-submit enforcement — tampered cookie-half / missing-cookie / tampered body-salt sign-in POSTs all rejected to csrf=true redirect; only paired tokens proceed

Bearer-key envelope: uniform 401 auth_error across 29 admin/config/user/team/key/budget/customer routes + provider passthrough roots (/gemini/,/anthropic/,/vertex_ai/) + plugin-token + metrics — zero keyless reads; provider credentials NOT exposed
Redirect sanitization: absolute-external, proto-relative, suffix-host, javascript:, data: callback variants all dropped/host-anchored on sign-in AND sign-out

Input handling: XSS ruled out BYTE-LEVEL (RSC serializer escapes before any script boundary; 26 odd-input variants uniform soft-404); no SQL channel (13 differentiated probes); strict typed 400s on demo API
Vhost isolation: unknown Host => 502, no cache/link poisoning; 20 internal vhosts = login walls or deterministic 404/403
Apex website: HSTS preload + X-Frame-Options DENY + nosniff + valid Let's Encrypt; CSRF structurally N/A (zero cookies); traversal/LFI/SSRF/DOM-injection dead; ports 2000/5060 silent
